803.body:
"Triple Red 777s" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. Of its unclaimed prize money, about three-quarters is in wins under $5,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.
